info.name: NC Admin API
info.summary: Server-side companion for the NC Admin Android app
info.description:
Small OCS API used by the NC Admin Android application.
* Marks the current app-password session as password-confirmed so that the standard Provisioning API write calls (which require `PasswordConfirmationRequired`) work from a mobile client authenticated with an app password + 2FA. * Bulk read of app config values. * Read/write of an allow-listed subset of `config.php` (mail server, logging, trusted domains, ...). * Sending a test e-mail.
All endpoints require a member of the `admin` group.
info.author: Tomas Popovas
